data.body: [P1] Hoisting this reference still does not make shutdown-time fatals observable: every outcome returns or throws from inside the `ExecutionManager` try-with-resources, with no `throwIfScopeFatal` after `close()`. After handoff times out, a scope can report `ThreadDeath`/`VirtualMachineError` while manager shutdown is blocked and the invocation still returns PENDING/RETRYING. Store the selected outcome until after resource closure, perform the final fatal check there, then return or rethrow it.
